mostWorthwhile.text: Hilling the potatoes was most worthwhile: the explanation connected the collar and added medium to keeping tubers from turning green.

leastWorthwhile.text: Extending the potato bed was the least informative moment on its own; its purpose became clear only after adding medium.

surprise.text: The explanation that new tubers need darkness under the lamps clarified why the bed needed both an extension and more medium.

arbitrary.text: No action ultimately felt arbitrary, though the initial extension result did not explain its purpose by itself.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the practical crop-support details were satisfying, though this short chapter offered little choice beyond the order of tasks.
